title: Among users located in the United Kingdom who own at least one post with 4
question: Among users located in the United Kingdom who own at least one post with 4 or more favorites, find those who also made a post edit in 2011, and return their display names along with the total number of posts they own.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(p."XCL_026") AS total_posts
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT p2."XCL_033"
      FROM posts AS p2
      WHERE p2."XCL_039" >= 4
  )
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT ph."XCL_017"
      FROM postHistory AS ph
      WHERE ph."XCL_013" = 5
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', ph."XCL_016") = '2011'
  )
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"

SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(p."XCL_026") AS total_posts
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT p2."XCL_033"
      FROM posts AS p2
      WHERE p2."XCL_039" >= 4
  )
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT ph."XCL_017"
      FROM postHistory AS ph
      WHERE ph."XCL_013" = 5
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', ph."XCL_016") = '2011'
  )
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"
